bias.label: Still under 3,630-3,650 after soft US PMI; leaning down below 3,650

event: Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US core PCE, GDP, durable goods, jobless claims (FOMC minutes time UNVERIFIED). Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, thin trade. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: No fresh price
bullets.text: The latest price I could confirm is December futures near 3,620 at about 14:40 SAST; the price after the 16:45 SAST PMI is UNVERIFIED, so check the live chart.

bullets.title: Ceiling not broken
bullets.text: Today's high so far is about 3,630-3,641, so price is still stuck under the 3,630-3,650 zone.

bullets.title: US PMI softer
bullets.text: US flash services PMI fell to 54.7 from 56.1, below forecasts near 55.5-55.7, and the composite fell to a four-month low of 54.6.

bullets.title: Dollar held up
bullets.text: The dollar kept its gains against the pound after the PMI, so the soft data did not knock the dollar much (DXY level UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hike bets high
bullets.text: CME FedWatch showed about 93% odds of a December hike on Monday, down from about 99% on Friday.

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold lost about 9% last week and touched about 3,503, so one strong day has not changed the bigger downtrend yet.

bullets.title: PCE on Wednesday
bullets.text: The big data this week is US core PCE and GDP on Wednesday at 15:30 SAST, before the Thanksgiving holiday thins trading.
